plan.name: Bound TLC checks and their memory
plan.summary: Give each gate invocation one shared TLC budget, used by full and model-only verification, existing Python applications, conformance batches, the larger check and stall retries, so independent checks wait for capacity and still report after another check fails. Choose concurrency from the selected Docker daemon's CPU count and memory: reserve a quarter of memory, allow at most one slot per CPU and one per 2 GiB container, scale a single container down on smaller machines, and use a conservative one-slot 1 GiB fallback when discovery is unavailable; invariant verify -tlc-parallel and verify.Options.TLCParallel use zero for automatic selection, reject negatives and only lower this ceiling. Give every TLC container an explicit maximum heap of three quarters of its memory limit and disable extra swap, keep slots until container cleanup completes, cancel queued work without starting it, and start silence and per-check time limits only after admission while retaining the caller's overall deadline. Report Java heap exhaustion and GC-overhead exhaustion as operational failures naming the check, report exit 137 as a killed check with possible memory exhaustion rather than asserting its cause, never accept partial violations as evidence after such failures, and preserve successful checks, configurations, example evidence and receipt fingerprints. Update SPEC.md and docs/gate.md with the resource policy, flag, cancellation and failure behavior, citing D-0016, D-0017, D-0047, D-0070, D-0111 and D-0306 as applicable; the merger must record the new resource-policy decision and complete its SPEC citation because this plumbing build cannot write decisions/.

tests.name: TestTLC497ResourceBudget
tests.says: tlc.NewBudget(cpus, memoryBytes, requestedParallel) returns a shared *Budget with Parallel, MemoryBytes and HeapBytes: slots fit CPUs and three quarters of Docker memory, a normal slot is 2 GiB with a 1536 MiB heap, smaller machines scale down to whole MiB, unavailable discovery uses one 1 GiB slot with a 768 MiB heap, a positive request can only lower concurrency, and negative requests or known budgets below a 256 MiB container are refused.

tests.name: TestTLC497GateBoundsEveryCheck
tests.says: verify.Run and RunModel accept optional verify.Options{TLCParallel: n}; a gate with fourteen independent model checks and multiple conformance batches starts at most two TLC containers with a limit of two, completes every independent result, and sends an explicit heap, container memory limit and equal memory-plus-swap limit on every run. Standalone runners without a Budget use a 1 GiB container and 768 MiB heap, including graph dumps.

tests.name: TestTLC497GateAutomaticBudget
tests.says: A gate without options discovers the selected Docker daemon's NCPU and MemTotal, lowers concurrency when either resource is smaller, safely falls back when discovery is malformed, and a requested high limit cannot raise the computed ceiling.

tests.name: TestTLC497MemoryFailureKeepsOtherResults
tests.says: A named design, witness, property, fairness, bug or conformance check that exhausts memory makes the gate fail with a memory diagnostic while the other independent checks finish; killed exit-137 checks also identify possible memory exhaustion without claiming a model violation.

tests.name: TestTLC497QueuedCancellationAndTimeout
tests.says: Runner copies sharing Budget never exceed it; a queued cancellation starts no container and wraps its cause, CheckWithin(ctx, dir, module, config, duration) gives an admitted check its whole execution timeout, and waiting does not consume the silence timeout.

tests.name: TestTLC497RetryHoldsCapacityThroughCleanup
tests.says: A stalled attempt retains its capacity through Docker removal, its identical retry obeys the shared limit, and a waiting successful check eventually completes without overlapping the removed container.

tests.name: TestTLC497OutOfMemoryIsNotCounterexample
tests.says: Java OutOfMemoryError, Java heap space and GC overhead limit exceeded override incomplete success or counterexample output, return a named Failed result rather than an ordinary violation, and never trigger a stall retry; unrelated failures keep their original classification.

tests.name: TestTLC497LimitsPreserveEvidenceAndReceipts
tests.says: The pinned examples' recorded TLC results pass through the bounded runner unchanged; successful gate JSON, Markdown, result order and fingerprints are identical across automatic, one-slot and two-slot schedules after removing only timestamps.

tests.name: TestTLC497VerifyFlag
tests.says: invariant verify documents -tlc-parallel as an automatic-by-default lowering limit, accepts zero and positive values without bypassing preflight, and rejects negative values before tool setup.
